title: 由勾股关系求直角三角形边长
stem:
如图，在\(\vartriangle ABC\)中，\(AC=BC\)，\(\angle ACB=90{}^\circ\)，点\(D\)在\(BC\)上，\(BD=6\)，\(DC=2\)，点\(P\)是\(AB\)上的动点，则\(PC+PD\)的最小值为_________．
〔图1〕
given_solution:
【分析】过点\(C\)作\(CO\bot AB\)于\(O\)，延长\(CO\)到\(C'\)，使\(O\) \(C'\)\(=OC\)，连接\(D\)\(C'\)，交\(AB\)于\(P\)，连接\(CP\)．此时\(DP+CP=DP+P\) \(C'\)\(=D\)\(C'\)的值最小．进而勾股定理，即可求解．
【详解】解：过点\(C\)作\(CO\bot AB\)于\(O\)，延长\(CO\)到\(C'\)，使\(O\) \(C'\)\(=OC\)，连接\(D\) \(C'\)，交\(AB\)于\(P\)，连接\(CP\)．此时\(DP+CP=DP+P\) \(C'\)\(=D\)\(C'\)的值最小．
\(\because BD=6\)，\(DC=2\)，\(\therefore BC=8\)，连接\(BC'\)，由对称性可知\(\angle C'BA=\angle CBA=45{}^\circ\)，
\(\therefore\)\(\angle CBC'=90{}^\circ\)，
\(\therefore\)\(BC'\bot BC\)，\(\angle BCC'=\angle BC'C=45{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore\)\(BC=BC'=4\)，根据勾股定理可得：\(DC'=\)\(\sqrt[] { B{C'}^{2} +BD ^ { 2 } }=\sqrt[] { 6 ^ { 2 } +8 ^ { 2 } }=10\)．
故答案为\(:10\)．
